hypothesis: The deprecated GEMSDOE29 artifact path lets the full-catalogue distance feature encode mapped-label membership; rebuilding catalogue features from fold-visible faults should remove that direct shortcut.
mechanism: Artifact training used all catalogue pixels as positives and derived E_dist from that same full label raster. The historical training sample therefore makes the positive label a deterministic function of E_dist. This review inspected public source and evidence read-only; it did not rerun the holdout. The legacy holdout also has an unresolved full-label negative-sampling dependency and does not report the required pooled DTI with a 95% interval.
named_non_fault_process: Fluvial incision can create linear stream-course lineaments that resemble terrain expressions attributed to faults; this is a plausible DEM-feature confounder, not tested in this run (USGS OFR 89-365).
